purpose: Select exactly one economically distinct offline three-session factor after terminal Campaign080, before opening any Campaign081 minute source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

definition_only_source_boundary.source: immutable accepted local Tushare 2019-2025 one-minute source and joint-clean stock-day identity

candidate_design_catalog.reason: The ratio of half-session endpoint displacement to the full within-half amount-path variation measures coherent directional migration of participation intensity rather than its level, clock location, concentration, peaks, threshold duration, or cross-day similarity.
Signed, morning-only, afternoon-only, and morning-minus-afternoon variants create an avoidable direction and subwindow search family.
Changing total absolute variation to a range, squared variation, or volatility normalization would be a same-family rescue.
Return jump concentration is too close to terminal return-variance entropy, diffusive-variation, variance-ratio, and extreme-shock mechanisms.
A weak-order entropy of amount changes would create another entropy/update-clock family after several terminal entropy and price-update definitions.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_amount_path_efficiency_238p
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A smoothly migrating intraday participation schedule can indicate coordinated multi-minute execution and persistent attention, which may support three-session continuation more reliably than a choppy amount path with the same endpoints.
selected_candidate.formula: Let x_i=log1p(amount_i) for the exact 240 bars. For morning indices 0..119 and afternoon indices 120..239, compute endpoint displacement E_h=abs(x_last-x_first) and total variation V_h=sum(abs(x_i-x_(i-1))) over the 119 within-half transitions. Return (E_morning+E_afternoon)/(V_morning+V_afternoon).
selected_candidate.time_grid: Exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00. The 09:30 row is source identity only and excluded. The lunch transition is excluded; each half starts a new path.
selected_candidate.amount_semantics: All 240 amounts must be finite and nonnegative. Exact zero amount is valid through log1p(0)=0. The score is missing only when pooled total variation is nonfinite or exactly zero, or when the source identity/grid is invalid.
selected_candidate.availability: Known at the signal-session close after the exact 240 amount bars; no future session, daily return, comparator, or Candidate49 observation is used.

decision.required_next_step: Complete and bind one exhaustive no-value mechanism-overlap audit; then freeze the no-return protocol, implementation, tests, and fingerprints before any candidate value.
